entities.summary: Abdumalik mosque is a cultural heritage site in Uzbekistan. Architectural monument. In 1913, the General Governorate of Turkestan in Namangan district of Fergana region established it. Currently, it is located in the "Yangi hayot" neighborhood of Gova village, Chust District, Namangan region. Abdumalik Mosque is a mosque in Asia, established in 1913. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
